rationale: The predecessor is the exact committed domain-pairs checker with its existing finite transition and old proof receipts untouched. The successor only passes an invocation-local parsed-input cache from the whole ledger reader into local-basis proof validation. Each continuity lookup still reads and compares the current complete catalog bytes, and all per-plan artifact byte/hash, original-cell, external-pair, local-proof, review and adjudication checks remain. The finite routine replays exact source edits and binds the new checker bytes; this is an implementation continuity record, not source truth or native acceptance.
